**id on

** _HTML attribute_ ```typescript id: HTMLElementTagNameMap["p"]["id"] ``` Native DOM attribute recognized by the Vue template compiler. Vue patches it on the platform element rather than resolving it as a component prop. **Runtime surface** DOM reflected attribute **Editor behavior** - Hover and go-to-definition use the DOM library type for the reflected property when the type service is available. - Component prop lookup is skipped because the enclosing tag is a native element. **Example** ```vue ``` **Docs** [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Global_attributes/id)

**v-bind()**

_Vue SFC CSS feature_

Bind a CSS value to component state. Vue compiles the expression to a hashed CSS custom property, updates it reactively on the component root, and supports both plain and scoped style blocks. Quote complex JavaScript expressions.

**Example**

```css
.text { color: v-bind('theme.color'); }
```

**Docs**

[Vue SFC CSS features](https://vuejs.org/api/sfc-css-features.html#v-bind-in-css)
